features.name: White-Label Brand System
features.description: Configurable brand identity for ghost kitchens and restaurants
acceptance: Avatar, colors, fonts, and copy are all swappable
Default brand is Nanny with chef.svg avatar
TypeScript types are strict and exported
test_steps: Call getNannyBrand() and verify default values
Call buildBrand({ name: 'Test' }) and verify override
Verify no secrets in brand config

features.name: Backend-for-Agents API Layer

acceptance: Mock responses work without real API keys

Verify mock mode returns structured data

features.name: LLM Router
features.description: Task-aware model routing with token telemetry
acceptance: Router selects model based on task type
test_steps: Verify telemetry object has all required fields
Test each task type routes to expected model tier
Verify provider is swappable via config
